exact: transposable element silencing by piRNA-directed DNA methylation
narrow: retrotransposon silencing by piRNA-directed DNA methylation

definition: A transposable element silencing mechanism mediated by Piwi-associated RNA (piRNA)-directed DNA methylation. This results in a heterochromatin assembly, a chromatin conformation that is refractory to transcription.
label: transposable element silencing by piRNA-mediated DNA methylation
